key_idea: Mark prints with at least 7 other prints within Manhattan distance 3 as core, prints within 3 of a core as valid too, then count components of valid prints under the distance-3 relation.
sketch: With at most 625 prints do everything in O(n^2): count neighbours within Manhattan distance 3 to find core prints, mark each print valid if it is core or within 3 of a core, union valid prints that are within 3 of each other. Jumps = components - 1, the third line is the number of invalid prints; with no valid print print No, 0 and the total print count. The statement is vague on what separates trails; I took any two valid prints within distance 3 to be on the same trail, which reproduces both samples. Only the samples back that interpretation.
